svg.desc: The streaming browser conversation carries history between fresh server turns. A first data question uses MCP to generate and execute SQL. Later turns can explain retained results, ask for clarification, or query again with earlier intent. History holds complete user/assistant pairs with SQL, explanation, metadata, and all loaded rows. oldest pairs are removed to meet 40-message and 120,000-character limits. MCP is shared infrastructure, not persistent conversation memory. Direct-answer and clarification decisions are prompt-guided.
